results.snippet: DeepSeek currently exposes two API model IDs: `deepseek-flash`, which serves DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (released September 10, 2026, with native image input). The legacy `deepseek-v4-flash` ID routes to V4.1 Flash. V4 Flash was retired on September 10, 2026.
results.title: DeepSeek Models: V4.1 Flash, V4 Pro, R1 & V3.2 Compared (October 2026)

results.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash went live on the official API on September 10, 2026. The model name is deepseek-flash. It replaces V4 Flash outright: the old deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp names still resolve, but the models behind them are retired.
results.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Pricing: Off-Peak and Peak Rates, Specs, and How to Access It (2026)

results.snippet: Current documented API IDs: `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and `deepseek-v4-pro` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813). Retired on September 10, 2026: DeepSeek-V4-Flash and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp. Latest official changelog entry: on September 10, 2026, DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
